title: CX Daily: For Wildlife That Survives the Heat, the Cost Often Comes Later
text:
TOP STORIES
In Depth: For Wildlife That Survives the Heat, the Cost Often Comes Later
The monkeys fell from the trees like ripe fruit, hitting the ground with a thud.
In May 2024, summer had come early and hard to the state of Chiapas in southern Mexico. In an ordinary year the temperature in the jungle would have topped out around 32 degrees Celsius. At the time, it was pushing 45 C.
